criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 1's rebuild is real and I am not going to undersell it: at 432 px (thumbs/slide-01-thumb.png) there IS a person in a lit patch now, the patch is a distinct bright parallelogram running lower-left to centre, the figure stands inside it, and the declared focal finally exists. That closes the thing three judges circled for three rounds. What still holds the frame down is the object the acceptance list names as its own scale check: the hydropneumatic tank prints as a soft pale ovoid at x 760-890, y 760-1150 (display 1600px), with NO saddles, NO contact where it meets the slab and NO east cast, and it is clipped by the dek block. The chassis header says in as many words that an object with no contact 'is wrong and gets redrawn rather than tuned'. The operator's own 3.5 m east cast does not separate from the silhouette either, where frame 9's is unmistakable, so the room reads as a room only in its horizontals (manifold, monitor, panel) and not in its masses. Bigger, and deck-wide: N.quiet still prints as a PLATE, which is the exact thing the criterion asks about. On frames 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 9 the hook and dek sit on a visibly LIGHTER warm rectangle, clearest on slide-04 where the field runs x 0-1035 and ends on a legible boundary that tracks the rag, because the wash paints #2E2016 over art that is N.G.deep #121014 or darker and therefore lightens it. Frame 3 is a second, separate miss: its dossier declares bleeds [bottom, right] and the acceptance item 'cropped by two edges', and the printed sheet floats with dark margin on all four sides (left 140, right 205, bottom 210 of 1600x2000), which is the 'slab in a void' the 5-band names. Frame 6's three sheets carry big empty hatched middles in blocks 1 and 2, so the detail budget is right only on the third. Graded, consistent, competent, with two frames (7, 9) I would show somebody, and three defects a designer would send back.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: This is the deck's strongest property and it is not close. One ground, one hatch at cell 6 angle 52, one furniture strip, one light: every cast I can check runs east (slide-09's figure and building, slide-07's box, slide-01's patch geometry). Measured arc 8.8/9.8/14.2/9.3/6.3/9.8/10.3/7.2/9.8, max adjacent 4.9 and mean 2.88 against this repo's historical 21.0 and the sibling's 2.6, so there is no strobe and no hard cut anywhere. The motif lands legibly four times (trace stops at the stylus on 2, the 87 row stops short of a rule that runs on to the margin on 6, every pack closed on 7, blank chart on 8). Frame 3 is still the break and it is more than the 'slightly outside' the 7 descriptor allows: canvas mean 85.1 against a 23.5 to 53.6 band for the other eight, next brightest 53.6. I still hold the round 4 note, and I hold it harder now that I can see the sheet did not take its declared two bleeds, because cropping it to two thirds and putting the bench shade back is the same edit that would make the dossier true. The second continuity device is half paid: I cannot recognise frame 5's centre building as frame 1's interior, and the plan_note concedes the exterior payoff on 9 never arrived.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Not my lens and I tried to break it anyway. Every numeral I can see on a slide has a home: 4,749 on 1 and 6 (v1), 3,579 and 87 on 6 (v2, v3), 3301 and 50000 appear only inside the printed query stanzas as the filters that produced the counts, the 5 m bar on 5 carries a computed_by naming compute.py with the metres-per-pixel derivation, and 2026-09-15 on 9 matches the startDate 09/15/2026 printed on frame 3's own retrieved metadata. Frame 3's c15 sentence reads character for character against the dossier's verbatim with no tidying. Frame 8's dek keeps the year on 2029 and drops it on September 15th, which is the house rule in the right direction. The one thing I would hand the integrity judge: frame 3's metadata rows print partly faded and the bottom two (FIELDS, RETRIEVED 2026-09-20) are cut by a lighter horizontal band, and render_report records 'rules': [] on every slide, so the strike detector cannot see canvas-drawn rules over canvas-drawn text at all.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader gets who (NSF funding Texas A&M), what (research into predictive digital twins), the honest state (frame 8, 'the word is can', nothing built, runs to 2029) and one thing to do that costs nothing (frame 9, ask for the annual drinking water quality report, TCEQ publishes it). The stake is real but structurally thin, because the story is an award rather than a decision with a date: there is no county body, no hearing, no deadline, and the deck is right not to invent one. Brazos County and the Post Oak Savannah are in the chassis and the storyboard and never once in the published copy, so the Texas specificity a reader actually sees is the count 4,749.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn is genuine and it is at 7: 'Every one of these is finished' re-reads six frames of well-kept records as the wrong instrument, and 8 lands it on one word. 1 to 4 build instrument by instrument, 6 sizes the set, 9 gives the exit. The cuttable frame is 5: at thumb size the elevation's three components sit in a thin band with the lower 40 percent given to soil hatch, and it restates in a diagram what 1 and 9 already showed in a room.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: 'Everything before now. Nothing after it.' and 'The log is current to this line.' are written rather than assembled, and the kicker 'One room, at ten to five' does more work than most deks. No boosterism, no doom, no colon or semicolon anywhere in the published copy, no first person. It is flat in one place: every dek is the same two-sentence explain-the-hook shape on all nine frames.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Warm iron-loam ground at a measured dE76 13.32 from its nearest neighbour in six decks, a hatch rather than the last deck's halftone, a nine-frame interior with one camera in one building, and an opening move that is an establishing shot rather than a number on a field. The familiar move is the furniture: kicker upper left, counter upper right, claim ids and site line at the foot, identical on all nine, and a hook set upper-left on eight of nine.

one_sentence_fix: Rewrite N.quiet to build ONE union mask from all the measured line boxes and paint it once, sampling the art under each region and laying #2E2016 only where the art is lighter than the ground and N.G.deep where it is already darker, because that single edit kills both the warm plate now visible on six of nine frames and the alpha the per-box loop composites to.
